description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git update-server-info' command. It contains a series of test cases that check the behavior of the command in various scenarios, including creating info/refs, modifying timestamps, avoiding unnecessary overwrites, ensuring updates occur when expected, and handling command-line options.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Sets up a commit with a specific file in the repository.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks that a specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_tool chmtime
methods.description: Changes the modification time of a file; usage: chmtime [=0 or timestamp] [file]

methods.name: test_tool chmtime --get
methods.description: Retrieves the modification time of a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files and validates their content difference or equality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output of a command.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a file or output is empty.
